exposure: Presence of bacteria in high vaginal swabs
cohort: Pregnant women and their newborn babies at a hospital in Bhaktapur, Nepal
finding: The study found a high proportion of adolescent pregnancies (4.7%) and low birth weight babies (13%), with low birth weight being independently associated with NICU admission.
mod_finding: The study does not specify if mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery) had any impact on the outcomes.
